name: Lightfoot Rogue — a d20 result row is an option of the trigger
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). The rows of a d20 table were read as static text: "It gets +1/+0 and gains deathtouch" gave every creature deathtouch, all the time. The rows are now the options of the ability that rolls (picked in the options pop-up) and are not parsed statically. Result 10—19: the Rogue is 3/1 with deathtouch; the Bears have nothing.
